recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No core source change is needed unless the Vocabulary WG reopens the broader abstract-code validation policy beyond FHIR-30343.
issue_request: FHIR-16334 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the STU3 CodeSystem $validate-code input parameter abstract. It asked to replace confusing wording about allowing abstract codes in the context of the code being validated and to correct the old record typo, while retaining a way for clients to indicate an abstract-code context.
initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 14658. Git history maps that to cb711b62fd/GF#16334, which replaced the old CodeSystem spreadsheet wording containing the obsolete value-set-specifications sentence and actual-recrod typo. The 2021 source rework carried the wording into the current OperationDefinition XML.
additional_context: FHIR-16338 and FHIR-16360 are parallel ValueSet issues in the same abstract-parameter family. FHIR-16482 and FHIR-16356 already have combined-branch audits for the same CodeSystem wording/typo family. FHIR-30343 later clarified that omitted abstract behaves like abstract=true and is already represented by a fixed commit; FHIR-30704 already audits later typo cleanup.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active CodeSystem operation definition already explains true/omitted and false behavior for abstract codes, preserves the intended contextual guidance, and lacks the obsolete typo and confusing original sentence.
